dxfull: Myocardial infarction (this slide: remote / healed), heart
desc:
General MI description (Section review 1.1):
*1. Cardiomyocyte coagulative necrosis
*① Dead cells with preserved cellular outlines
*② Cytoplasmic eosinophilia
*③ Nuclear changes: karyolysis, pyknosis, karyorrhexis
2. Interstitial edema and hemorrhage
3. An inflammatory infiltrate (neutrophils or macrophages)
4. Granulation tissue (capillary and fibroblast proliferation)
5. Fibrosis / scar formation (dense collagen deposition)
This slide (PA0335, remote MI):
*1. Multifocal fibrosis replacing myocytes (remote change); slightly increased mononuclear inflammatory cells
2. Granulation tissue, focal (hard to find; recent change): neovascularization (capillary proliferation), hemorrhage
3. Myocyte vacuolization, especially subendocardial areas (sublethal ischemic change)
4. Hypertrophic changes of cardiomyocytes (patient background): increased cell and nuclear size
Also: lipofuscin (perinuclear, normal aging)
note: PA0335 (6) — 69M; listed as PA0004 (6) Myocardial infarction, heart in Section review 1.2
